source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Open the inspection records related to the building accessibility checks. Make sure to include:

a. Building address and unique identifier (if applicable).
b. Date and time of inspection.
c. Name(s) of the inspector(s).

3. List all applicable accessibility standards and regulations pertinent to the building type (e.g., ADA, local building codes, AS1428.1, etc.).

4. Indicate sections of the building assessed (e.g., entrance, exit, parking, restrooms, ramps, elevators, signage).

5. For each failed check:
  
   a. Precisely describe the location (e.g., "Main entrance on the north side").

   b. Specify which standard/regulation was not met (e.g., "ADA § 405 - Ramps").

   c. Provide a detailed description of the issue (e.g., "The slope of the ramp exceeds the maximum allowable gradient of 1:12").

   d
